messages:
julia (People Ops): Hey team — quick heads up: planning a small recognition drop next Wed (10/11) called ‘Spark Stickers’ to celebrate micro-wins. Goal: 300 stickers across offices, small desk cards, and a digital shoutout. Need volunteers for ordering, pickup, and distribution. Thoughts? :sparkles:

samir (Ops): love it. timeline? can volunteer for pickup if it's on campus. :thumbsup:

ava (People Ops): ordering needs to be this Friday to hit lead times. budget approved up to $600 by finance per last month’s micro-recog budget. michelle, confirm?

michelle (Finance): confirmed — $600 cap, please keep receipts and submit expense form. If we go over, escalate to me.

julia (People Ops): thanks. plan: order 300 stickers + 350 desk cards (extra). volunteers: samir (pickup), mike (sticker station setup in lobby), ava (distribution coord). Ops-bot will post a reminder day before.

mike (Facilities): can set up two stations (HQ lobby + 4th floor) between 10am-2pm. need sign holders and a small card box. i have spare sign holders.

ava (People Ops): distribution checklist: 
- 2 stations staffed 11:30-1:30
- labeled envelope for each manager with 10 stickers
- digital shoutout template ready
I’ll make a tiny sheet and share.

julia (People Ops): ordering details: vendor is StickrCo, SKU `SPK-25`, finish: matte. link: <https://vendor.example.com/order?sku=SPK-25|order page>. Please use PO # PO-2109 when checking out. I'll paste the PO in #procurement after we confirm.

samir (Ops): can you paste sizes? need to confirm pocket dispensers fit.

julia (People Ops): stickers 2in round. desk cards 3.5x2in.

michelle (Finance): ping me the final invoice pdf after order, I’ll route for payment.

ava (People Ops): volunteers for distribution shift: @samir 11:30-12:15, @sasha? 12:15-1:00 (cc: ops-bot will run the volunteer signup modal). Anyone else?

mike (Facilities): I’ll bring the sign holders and tape. do we want branded tablecloth?

julia (People Ops): not necessary this round — simple look is fine. we’re trying for low touch.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — automatic reminder will post in #people-ops Tue 10/10 9:00am.

samir (Ops): ordering ok on my side, can pickup Mon 10/10 evening if it arrives early.

ava (People Ops): Action items: 
- julia: place order by Fri EOD and paste invoice (ts:1720004400)
- samir: pickup and confirm ETA
- mike: bring signage + tape
- michelle: process invoice after upload
- ava: make distribution sheet + digital shoutout template

julia (People Ops): tagging timeline: I'll order by Fri 5pm. if anyone has vendor issues, DM me. :pray:

mike (Facilities): :ok_hand:

samir (Ops): thanks — excited for this. small things matter. :sparkles:

ava (People Ops): will share the distribution sheet by Mon 10/9 noon (ts:1720004785).
